description: Add presentation-only warning states: whole Frame Conn palette pulses red during an imminent reactor meltdown; Heat telemetry pulses yellow-orange in Danger Zone and yellow-red while Exposed.

operations.replace:
repairsMax:
      0,

    meltdownImminent:
      false,

    dangerZoneActive:
      false,

    exposedActive:
      false
  };

actorType:
      actor.type ??
      null,

    meltdownImminent:
      system.meltdown_timer !== null &&
      system.meltdown_timer !== undefined &&
      system.meltdown_timer !== "",

    dangerZoneActive:
      Boolean(
        system.statuses?.dangerzone
      ),

    exposedActive:
      Boolean(
        system.statuses?.exposed
      ),

    repairsAvailable
